reachability.verdict: cannot start. The very first failure is at INSTALL time, not import time: packages/cli/package.json declares 27 @xiranite/node-* dependencies with the workspace:* protocol and packages/api declares 2 (@xiranite/file-operations, @xiranite/services), and none of those 29 packages exist in the Xaihi workspace - pnpm refuses the whole install (verified by enumerating every workspace:* specifier against the 16 package names in packages/* + plugins/*). Nothing was installed or built, so dist/index.js (the bin target) does not exist either.

layers.detail: 29 dangling workspace:* refs (cli: 27 @xiranite/node-*, api: @xiranite/file-operations + @xiranite/services). pnpm answers these with ERR_PNPM_WORKSPACE_PKG_NOT_FOUND ("Cannot find package with name X in workspace", the documented behaviour for a workspace:* specifier with no matching workspace package) - stated from pnpm's documented contract, deliberately NOT verified by running install, which is out of scope here. Either those packages are ported, or the lines are dropped/renamed - which is the rename decision reserved to the user.

no dist/ exists and builds were deliberately not run. packages/api cannot typecheck until file-operations/services exist (their imports are type-only, so they are erased at runtime but not at compile time). Toolchain also differs: copied packages want typescript ^7.0.2 + @types/node ^24.12.0, Xaihi uses typescript ^6 + @types/node ^22 + tsdown.

packages/cli/src/index.ts:7 - import { localizeNodeHelp } from "@xiranite/contract". @xiranite/contract is NOT in packages/cli/package.json#dependencies (verified: 34 deps, no contract). It resolves in noxide only because bun workspaces hoist everything to the root node_modules; Xaihi is pnpm@12.6.0 with the default strict/isolated layout, so packages/cli gets no contract link and the entry dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any command is parsed. This is the only undeclared workspace specifier in the whole copied set. Fix is one dependency line, not a code change.

await import(`${registration.packageName}/cli`) at packages/cli/src/index.ts:196 is unguarded (loadNodeCli has no try/catch; it bubbles to the top-level catch at :412-418, which prints the message and sets exitCode=1). With @xiranite/* kept as written, all 46 registry entries hit ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. After mapping to @hibernalglow/xaihi-<id>, the 4 migrated nodes hit ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED because those packages export only ., ./locale/*.json, ./cordis.patch.yml, ./package.json - no ./cli. The /help lookup at :205 IS wrapped in try/catch and degrades to `<node> --help`.
